mentions.name: CPU-only data-science and ML benchmark
mentions.description: A CPU-only benchmark for typical data-science and ML tasks that can be run on multiple systems to compare their performance and help decide which next system to buy.
mentions.problem: Uncertainty about how different systems, such as Apple silicon, perform on typical data-science and ML tasks when choosing hardware.
mentions.source_excerpt: A CPU only benchmark for typical data-science and ML tasks that I can run on a few different systems that will help me figure out what the next system I should buy is. I have no idea what Apple silicon is like for these tasks.

evidence.value: A CPU only benchmark for typical data-science and ML tasks that I can run on a few different systems that will help me figure out what the next system I should buy is. I have no idea what Apple silicon is like for these tasks.
